prompt:
Photorealistic rear-view portrait of an adult person,
head and upper torso visible,
both shoulders clearly visible,
neutral natural posture,
simple uncluttered indoor background,
natural photographic lighting,
realistic individual hair strands,
realistic hair volume,
realistic hair silhouette,
high-detail natural photography.

The camera must show enough of the upper torso that the relationship
between the hair ends and the shoulders/chest/back can be visually judged.

Medium brown wavy hair with natural subtle variation.

Do not crop the shoulders.
Do not crop the hair ends.
Do not hide the hair behind clothing.
Do not use an extreme camera angle.
Do not create an illustration or painting.


IMPORTANT HAIR-LENGTH REQUIREMENT:

Target taxonomy category: LONG

Operational landmark:
CHEST_OR_UPPER_BACK

Required visual relationship:
hair extends clearly to the chest or upper-back region

Taxonomy definition:
Hair extends to approximately chest level or upper back.

The hair-length relationship to the visible body landmarks must be
visually obvious enough for an independent human evaluator to determine
the category from the image alone.

Do not add text, labels, arrows, measurement lines, diagrams,
or annotations to the image.


illustration, painting, cartoon, anime, fantasy,
cropped shoulders, cropped hair,
hair hidden by clothing,
extreme close-up,
extreme camera angle,
blurred hair,
unrealistic hair,
floating hair,
multiple people

target_annotation.definition: Hair extends to approximately chest level or upper back.
